about.title: A disabled veteran's roofing company, built on 25+ years in Houston
text: Gifford Roofing is a 100% disabled veteran owned company, and our team has 25+ years of experience.
We install and repair roofs for homeowners and commercial property owners, from minor repairs to complete replacements.
Our training and experience have let us grow our Houston roofing company to cover Katy, Sugar Land, Pearland and the cities around them.
When a claim is involved, we work with your insurance company so you don't have to carry that alone.
